GamerTweak: How To Get & Use Skill Points In Hunter Call Of The Wild

about: Skills (Stalker and Ambusher trees) and perks (Rifles, Handguns, Shotguns, Archery). Effects are paraphrased from community sources, not copied from the in-game text. Skill trees unlock tier by tier by points spent in that tree; perk trees unlock by prerequisite perk.

pointsEarned.about: Skill points and perk points are earned by levelling up the hunter. XP comes from harvesting animals, discovering outposts, lookout points and points of interest, and completing missions. Maximum hunter level is 60. Skill and perk points alternate every level up to level 37; after that one point is given every 3 levels. A full character earns 22 skill points and 22 perk points, so not everything can be maxed (the skill trees hold 44 points and the perk trees hold 42).
pointsEarned.reset: Skills and perks can be reset for in-game cash. Cost rises with points spent: 3,500 per point according to a 2019 Steam thread (154,000 for 44 points). It may have changed since.

notes: Tier thresholds (1/5/9/13 points spent) and most per-level effects come from NamuWiki and were not checked against the in-game text. No English source found gives exact per-level percentages for most skills and perks; where a level's specific effect is unknown it is null or 'Further improvement'. Perk names follow the English game; NamuWiki's 'Embodiment' is listed here as Muscle Memory (unverified).
